purpose.en: Bring SmartLingo's public and signed-in navigation to the proven SmartClass hamburger interaction while keeping all twelve text-only language choices available on desktop and mobile.
purpose.zh: 将 SmartLingo 登录前后导航统一为已验证的 SmartClass 汉堡菜单交互，并在桌面和移动端保留全部 12 种纯文字语言选项。

en: Use one dark hamburger control that animates into a close icon on small screens.
Place primary navigation, twelve text-only languages, and account actions in one full-width mobile drawer.
Show Sign in or register before login and the complete account navigation after login.
Keep the same twelve-language text style in the desktop language menu.
zh: 小屏使用一个深色汉堡按钮，打开后动画变为关闭图标。
在全宽移动抽屉中统一放置主导航、12 种纯文字语言和账户操作。
登录前显示“登录或注册”，登录后显示完整账户导航。
桌面语言菜单也使用同一套 12 种纯文字样式。

en: Replace the legacy details popover with an accessible state-driven responsive drawer.
Add mobile-aware account rendering without duplicating account destinations.
Use one shared twelve-language option source for desktop and mobile.
Add regression contracts for menu state, language count, account states, and responsive styling.
zh: 以具备无障碍状态的响应式抽屉替换旧 details 小弹窗。
新增移动端账户呈现，同时不复制账户目的地逻辑。
桌面与移动端共用同一个 12 语言选项来源。
新增菜单状态、语言数量、账户状态和响应式样式回归门禁。

en: Production build, artifact validation, sensitive-data scan, and all 298 automated tests passed.
Chrome 430 px test verified a 12-language drawer, no horizontal overflow, close animation state, and Escape dismissal.
Safari desktop test verified the same twelve text-only language choices; created test tabs were closed afterward.
zh: 生产构建、部署产物校验、敏感信息扫描和全部 298 项自动测试通过。
Chrome 430 像素测试确认 12 语言抽屉、无横向溢出、关闭图标状态和 Escape 关闭。
Safari 桌面测试确认同一套 12 种纯文字语言；测试结束后已关闭新建标签页。

en: No product feature, learner data, or account permission changes are included in this navigation-only release.
zh: 本次仅更新导航，不包含产品功能、学习数据或账户权限变更。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's independent brand, course routes, account routes, twelve-language learning catalog, and site-local deployment resources.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 独立品牌、课程路由、账户路由、12 语言学习目录及本站独立部署资源。
